messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I think I might have lost my wallet with both of my debit cards in it. I have two checking accounts with you — my Bluest Account and my Light Green Account. I’ve been looking everywhere and I can’t find my wallet. I’m not 100% sure it’s gone but I’m getting worried about both cards.

Sorry to hear that — I can help. Since you have two checking accounts with Rho-Bank (Bluest and Light Green), you can either temporarily freeze each debit card (if you think the wallet is misplaced and might turn up) or close (permanently cancel) any card that you're sure is lost or stolen. Quick notes:
- Freeze = temporary lock you can reverse later; all new transactions (including recurring payments) will be declined while frozen.
- Close = permanent deactivation; use this if you’re confident the card is gone or stolen. Closed cards cannot be reactivated and you’d need replacement cards.
- If a card is lost/stolen we’ll also offer replacement cards and follow our cross-product security checks (we’ll check for any Rho credit cards and offer protection if applicable).
- Under Regulation E, reporting quickly limits your liability for unauthorized debit card transactions.

Before I can take any action (freeze or close cards, order replacements, or check for credit cards) I need to verify your identity. Please tell me which you’d like to do now for each account (freeze or close), and provide any two of the following to verify you:
- Date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY)
- Email on file
- Phone number on file
- Mailing address on file

Once you tell me which action you want for each card and provide two of the verification fields above, I’ll proceed. If you’d prefer to just get guidance for now, tell me and I’ll explain the next steps without making changes.

Please freeze BOTH cards right away. That way if someone finds my wallet they can’t use either card. I’ll keep looking.

For verification, here are two items:
- Date of birth: 04/12/2002  
- Phone number: 312-555-0847

I can do that — I just need one piece of account lookup info so I can verify the two items you already gave (DOB and phone) and proceed to freeze both cards.

Please provide ONE of the following (exactly as on file) so I can look up your account:
- Full name, OR
- Rho‑Bank user ID, OR
- Email address on file

- Mobile app: Open the Rho‑Bank app → tap Cards → select the debit card → toggle "Freeze Card" (repeat for each card).  
- Phone: Call Rho‑Bank customer support at the number on our website and tell the agent you want both debit cards frozen; they’ll verify your identity over the call.
